about: Names two listings by street, adds a parking question, gives two evenings and refuses booking

lines.say: I'm looking for a two bedroom, up to 3,200.
Please call the one on Keele Street and the one on Exbury Road.
Ask them whether parking is included in the rent.
I'm free Tuesday or Thursday evening, from 6 to 8.
Don't book anything yet, just find out and text me.
